name: Takane no Hana to Mahou no Tsubo
source:
I am a high school boy living alone in an apartment. The other day, I received my older brother's belongings who suddenly passed away. A suspicious vase? I came across something like that. I heard that it seemed to be a good stuff, but...

One day, an unknown object came out of it. "I'm Tsuboi-san, the spirit of this vase." he introduced himself. Ah, I must be dreaming. The spirit said that as a gratitude for removing the seal, he would grant me three wishes.

"If so, I want to bang somebody over and over! Just kidding." I replied lightly. It was a dream after all.

"Since there are three wishes, you can have up to three people as well, it's OK!"

Three people? Well, as long as I could bang somebody, then that was enough, I thought.

"I'll decide your partners for you! Rest assured that I'll choose them properly!" Tsuboi-san said confidently.

The next morning, I got out of bed thinking that I had a strange dream. However, I found Tsuboi-san eating bread on the table. Was I still dreaming? Wasn't that a dream?

Tsuboi-san said that the women who he had selected were at the school, so he climbed up on my shoulder and we went there together. It looked like no one else could see Tsuboi-san.

At lunch, the student council room. Kasagi Aoi-senpai, the student council president who usually does not show up during lunch break, appeared.

"That girl is nice, isn't she?" Tsuboi-san pointed at senpai. I panicked, no matter how you look at it, that was impossible!

"You doubt my ability?" said Tsuboi-san.
"No, it's not that."
"Trust me." Tsuboi-san seemed very confident that day.

The next day, while I was assisting the discipline committee with uniform inspection, Tagawa Ichika-senpai, a famous [i]gyaru[/i] at the school, stopped in front of me.

"Eh, what, are you going to give me a warning?" senpai slowly approached.
"It's decided! Let's choose this girl as the second one!" Tsuboi-san suddenly declared.

And as the time to leave school drew near, the infirmary door opened and the nurse, Seo Kanna-sensei came out.

"Ah, just in time, could you come over here?" she invited me to the infirmary.
"Don't tell me that Kanna-sensei is the third person?"
"That's right." Tsuboi-san replied.

Seriously? A sensei who just arrived this year, beautiful, kind, and is very famous for her terrific breasts.

I left the school feeling fluffy.

"I'm sorry for doubting you, Tsuboi-san."
"If you're believing me now, then it's fine."
"I do, I truly believe you now."
"It's going to be even tougher starting tomorrow." said Tsuboi-san.
"I'm really going to be doing it with those three, huh?"

"Leave it to me!" Tsuboi-san said proudly.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1206508&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
我是一个独自住在公寓里的高中生。有一天，我收到了突然去世的哥哥的遗物。可疑的花瓶？我遇到过类似的事情。我听说这似乎是个好东西，但是……

有一天，从里面钻出一个不明物体。“我是这个花瓶的灵魂，坪井同学。”他做了自我介绍。啊，我一定是在做梦。神灵说，作为解除封印的感谢，他会满足我三个愿望。

“如果是这样，我想一遍又一遍地殴打某人！开个玩笑。”我淡淡地回答道。这毕竟是一个梦。

“既然有三个愿望，那么最多也可以有三个人，没关系！”

三个人？好吧，只要我能打到别人，那就足够了，我想。

“我会为你选择伙伴的！放心，我一定会选好！”坪井同学自信地说。

第二天早上，我起床以为自己做了一个奇怪的梦。然而，我发现坪井同学正在桌子上吃面包。我还在做梦吗？那不是一个梦吗？

坪井先生说他选的女人就在学校里，于是他爬上我的肩膀，我们一起去了学校。看来没有人能看到坪井同学了。

午餐时，学生会室。平时午休时不露面的学生会长笠木葵前辈登场了。

“那个女孩很不错，不是吗？”坪井同学指着学长。我惊慌失措，无论怎么看，这都不可能！

“你怀疑我的能力？”坪井先生说道。
“不，不是那样的。”
“相信我。”那天坪井先生显得非常自信。

第二天，当我协助纪律委员会进行制服检查时，学校里有名的[i]gyaru[/i]田川一花学长停在了我面前。

“呃，怎么，你要警告我吗？”学长慢慢靠近。
“就这样决定了！就选这个女孩为第二吧！”坪井同学突然说道。

临近放学的时间，医务室的门打开了，护士徐神奈老师走了出来。

“啊，正好，你能过来一下吗？”她邀请我去医务室。
“难道神无老师是第三人吗？”
“这是正确的。”坪井同学回答道。

严重地？今年刚来的老师，美丽、善良，以巨乳闻名。

我离开学校的时候感觉很松软。

“抱歉，坪井同学怀疑了你。”
“如果你现在相信我的话，那就没问题了。”
“是的，我现在真的相信你了。”
“从明天开始，情况会更加艰难。”坪井先生说道。
“我真的要和那三个人一起做，嗯？”

“交给我吧！”坪井同学自豪地说。
